factors.label: Gram panchayat layout only
factors.headline: A panchayat-only layout is not an approved layout, and most lenders will not fund it.
factors.detail: Panchayats have no power to approve layouts inside the HMDA area; plots in these layouts are sold as approved constantly. Without regularisation the buyer cannot get a building permission, and the resale pool shrinks to cash buyers.

evidence.source: Answered by you — not independently verified

factors.label: Corner plot
factors.headline: Two open sides — better light, better access, and shop-front potential.
factors.detail: Corner plots carry a standing premium in Hyderabad layouts, larger where the second road is also wide.

evidence.source: Answered by you — not independently verified

outstandingQuestions.question: Has it been regularised under LRS or BRS?
outstandingQuestions.because: A panchayat-era layout without regularisation cannot get a building permission, and the pending fee lands on the buyer.

outstandingQuestions.question: Which direction does it face?
outstandingQuestions.because: Facing carries a measurable premium in Hyderabad, not merely a sentimental one — east and north plots resell faster.

outstandingQuestions.question: Is the plot physically fenced and in the seller's possession?
outstandingQuestions.because: Paper ownership and physical possession part company often enough in peri-urban Hyderabad that lenders check it separately.

anchor.note: Statutory rate for Ghatkesar mandal — no separate rate listed for this village, uplifted 1.9x to a traded level. Statutory rates are a stamp-duty floor, not a market price. Snapshot of 2026-08-25 — confirm on the IGRS portal before relying on it.
